create_m2m100_tokenizer: create an M2M100 tokenizer from a pretrained model with source and target language codes
build_translation_inputs: build translation inputs for the generate function with source and target language settings
prepare_seq2seq_batch: prepare a seq2seq batch with source texts, source language, target texts, and target language
save_tokenizer_vocabulary: save the tokenizer vocabulary and sentencepiece model to a directory
set_src_lang_special_tokens: set source language special tokens with prefix language id and suffix eos token
